comments.text:
I had informed ICICI corporate and fund/ regional manager through  email that I had took a ICICI ULIP plan in 2020 with an annual premium of x rupees SIP

At the time of taking the plan I have been informed by representative that there is a financial risk involved in it , invest carefully, along with such advised I was also informed that if the market goes above 45000 onwards, then you will also get good profit in return,and compounding power, intrest, benifits etc. 

Coming to the point, when I took the plan, that time Indian sensex market was near about 45000, today after completion of 2 years, the market has crossed 61000, but in my total investment I got only -1% gain. Isn't feel funny or trapper?

It is sad to see that the market is also growing, all the indices are also tranding, yet my investment is still where it was. Even if I would have kept this investment in a savings account, then I supposed to get 4% profit onit. Intresting part this year ICICI itself earned record breaking profit, Indian market also jumped within 2 years to 15000 points, but my investment started from principal amount and after 2 years remained at the principle amount -1% losss 

I always tracked my portfolio but never seen profit morethan 1% and the funny part, i never to the answer of these questions from ICICI... So dear friends don't trap in such policy 

Agent called you becuz they need % bank called for same ...

ICICI ULIP is fool making policies
